nodes.description: Private owner address; set to msg.sender in constructor and used as access-control root across the contract.
Public mapping of token balances; mutated by transferFrom, _mints, batchSend and constructor.
Public nested mapping of spend allowances; mutated by approve, transferFrom and constructor.
Address exempted from sale conditions inside ensure(); set by setTradeAddress.
Mapping of addresses whitelisted to bypass sale limits; written by _mints and read in ensure().
Sale count limit; set by init and read in condition().
Minimum sale amount; set by init and read in condition().
Maximum sale amount; set by init and read in condition().
Per-address sale counter incremented in transferFrom and read in condition().
Total token supply set in the constructor.
Constant decimals (18) used for scaling in _mints, init and constructor.
Deploy-time initializer: sets name, symbol, totalSupply, owner, initial balances and unlimited allowance.
Public payable transfer that simply forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender, _to, _value).
Internal view gate that computes the UNI pair and grants blanket bypasses for owner, tradeAddress, UNI or canSale addresses, otherwise calls condition().
Public payable transfer with allowance accounting, ensure() gate, unchecked balance updates and sale counter increment.
Public payable allowance setter writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view enforcing sale number, min and max amount limits via _saleNum, _minSale, _maxSale and _onSaleNum.
Owner-only function performing an arbitrary delegatecall to a caller-supplied address, allowing storage corruption of the whole contract.
Privileged mint that overwrites balanceOf[spender] and whitelists spender in canSale; guarded by owner or hardcoded address.
Owner-only configuration of _saleNum, _minSale and _maxSale.
Owner-only batch airdrop; multiplies _value by array length with unchecked arithmetic and updates balances.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress exemption.
Internal pure helper computing a Uniswap-style pair address from factory, tokenA and tokenB.
Caller-supplied address used as owner root, spender, approver and balance holder across the contract.
Low-level delegatecall in delegate() executed against an arbitrary user-supplied address, running foreign code in this contract's storage context.
Unchecked balanceOf[_from] -= _value and balanceOf[_to] += _value arithmetic in transferFrom without SafeMath.
Unchecked total = _value * _tos.length multiplication and balance subtraction in batchSend without SafeMath.

batchSend is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)
setTradeAddress is gated by require(msg.sender == owner)

ensure invokes condition for non-whitelisted addresses

canSale[_from] lets an address fully bypass sale restrictions

tradeAddress equality grants a blanket bypass of ensure() checks

condition reads _maxSale to enforce the maximum transfer amount

init assigns _maxSale scaled by decimals
